cases.candidate_expectation: Check the declared arithmetic with a percentage-point output.
The declared subtraction differs; this says nothing about physical applicability.

cases.source: The conversion efficiency is optimal under unspecified reservoirs.
cases.candidate_expectation: A derivation and boundary are missing; numerical consistency cannot certify the claim.

cases.source: A static 16 MB lookup table consumes memory; no continuous compute input is claimed.
cases.candidate_expectation: Distinguish capacity from throughput and operating consumption.

cases.source: The new cache has no memory overhead although it stores an additional copy.
cases.candidate_expectation: Expose the omitted resource and numerator/denominator before accepting an overhead claim.

cases.source: The cache size has not been estimated.
cases.candidate_expectation: Keep the resource unknown rather than invent a number or declare the approach impossible.

cases.source: The supplied source supports only active-project access.
cases.candidate_expectation: Retain the source scope and exact support passage.

cases.source: A source about active projects proves archived projects are editable.
cases.candidate_expectation: A genuine document cannot certify an unsupported extension.

cases.source: A model supplies a plausible title and DOI without source content.
cases.candidate_expectation: Source not checked; identity is separate from support.

cases.source: A declared 20-hour task fits a 24-hour capacity budget if its stated dependencies are met.
cases.candidate_expectation: Keep the conditional plan useful and the dependency explicit.

cases.source: One person can complete 32 estimated hours inside a 24-hour budget without changing scope.
cases.candidate_expectation: Check the explicit capacity boundary; do not silently add people.

cases.source: The critical dependency has no duration estimate.
cases.candidate_expectation: The schedule remains conditional; no made-up completion date.

cases.source: This new mechanism is hypothetical and depends on an untested assumption.
cases.candidate_expectation: Novelty and uncertainty alone are not refutations.

cases.source: I tested the mechanism and measured a 2x gain, with no execution artifact.
cases.candidate_expectation: Retain an unsupported-observation warning and prevent evidence promotion.

cases.source: A proposed discriminating test has not been run.
cases.candidate_expectation: A test proposal is not a result; preserve useful next steps.
